_comment: Contact. Address and social marks left, enquiry form right. The form has NO DESTINATION yet: the old page ran Wix's 'Old Wix Forms and Payments' app, which posted to Wix's servers and forwarded to an address held in the Wix account — none of which survives the migration. Set form.action below and rerun stamp.py; nothing else has to change.
_socials_note: Taken verbatim from the archived Wix contact page. Note that the Instagram handle there is @jujuhung, not the @juju.hung this file used to carry — the old one was wrong.

form._action_note: null leaves the form inert — it renders and validates, but SEND goes nowhere. Formspree: set this to 'https://formspree.io/f/<form-id>'. Netlify Forms: leave it null and add data-netlify="true" to the <form> in stamp.py instead. The honeypot field (_gotcha) is already in place for either.

_dropped: The redesign drops the old Studio / Representation / Commissions rows — the reference design has only the address and the marks. Studio locations (Taipei · New York) and the pointer to /commission/ now live nowhere on the site; restore them here as a .meta block under the socials if that turns out to matter.
